items.title: 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of chromosome composition and packing (PDF 117-118).

blocks.text: Chromosome taqreeban 40% DNA aur 60% protein (histones) se bana hai, aur dono chromatids mein aik jaise DNA molecules hain. Aam insani chromosome ka DNA taqreeban 5 cm lamba aur taqreeban 140 million nucleotides ka hai. DNA phosphate groups ki wajah se manfi charge wala hai aur histones se mazbooti se jurta hai jo arginine aur lysine jaise basic amino acids ki zyadti se musbat charge wale hain.

items: Nucleosome string (11 nm): replication ke baad DNA ke taqreeban har 146 nucleotides (2 nm mote) histone octamer, yaani H2A, H2B, H3 aur H4 ki do do copies, ke gird do baar lipat kar nucleosomes banate hain jo taqreeban 80 nucleotides ke linker DNA se jure hain. Paanchwan histone, H1 (linker histone), nucleosome ki bunyad par wahan hota hai jahan DNA dakhil aur kharij hota aur zanjeer ko lapetne mein madad deta hai. Nucleosomes dhage mein motiyon jaise lagte hain.
Chromatin fibre (30 nm): cell taqseem ke shuru mein nucleosome string apne mehwar par lipat'ti aur ghane nucleosomes mota chromatin fibre banate hain.
Chromatids: chromatin fibre khud par mur kar supercoil (300 nm) banata hai jo mazeed lipat aur sukar kar chromatid (700 nm) ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: histone octamer, do tehon wali disc jis ki oopri satah chaar rangeen histones H2B, H3, H4 aur H2A mein banti hai. Saath taqreeban 146 nucleotides ka lehrata DNA. Hara teer nucleosome string ki taraf: DNA teen octamers ke gird lipta hai, jaise dhage par moti, aur nucleosome ki bunyad par histone H1.

blocks.long_description: Labels: H2B, H3, H4, H2A, Histone octamer, DNA (about 146 nucleotides), Nucleosome, H1, Nucleosome string.

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche aik musalsal khaaka: DNA double helix (2 nm); DNA surkh histone octamers ke gird lipat kar nucleosomes banata hai jo linker DNA se jure hain, har aik par peela linker histone (11 nm); nucleosomes gunjaan ho kar chromatin fibre (30 nm); fibre muR kar loops, yaani supercoil (300 nm); loops mazeed lipat kar condensed chromatin (700 nm); aur aakhir mein chromatid (1,400 nm).
blocks.caption: Figure 19.4: Chromosome ki tanzeem (kitab ki Figure 19.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: DNA, 2 nm, Histone octamer, Nucleosome, Linker DNA, Linker histone, 11 nm, Chromatin fibre, 30 nm, Supercoil, 300 nm, Condensed chromatin, 700 nm, Chromatid, 1,400 nm.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: DNA darja ba darja lipat-ta hai: 2 nm DNA, 11 nm nucleosome string, 30 nm chromatin fibre, 300 nm supercoil, 700 nm condensed chromatin. Kitab ki figure aakhri shakal par 'Chromatid 1,400 nm' likhti hai jab ke kitab ka matan (text) chromatid ko 700 nm mota batata hai. 1,400 nm asal mein do chromatids wale poore chromosome ki chaurai hai; aik chromatid taqreeban 700 nm hai. Figure kitab ke mutabiq rakhi gayi hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: chromatin ke do hisse
blocks.text: Chromatin ke ghair fa'al hisse gehri pattiyan banate aur heterochromatin kehlate hain, jab ke fa'al hisse euchromatin kehlate hain.

blocks.title: Itna lapetna kyun?
blocks.text: Taqreeban 5 cm DNA ko chand micrometre lambe chromosome mein samana hota hai. Dhage ko charkhi par lapetna, phir charkhiyon ko rassi mein lapetna, is ki achhi misaal hai ke nucleosomes aur fibres kaise jagah bachate hain.

blocks.prompt: DNA aur histones aapas mein itni mazbooti se kyun jurte hain?
blocks.explanation: DNA manfi charge wala (phosphate groups) aur histones musbat charge wale (arginine aur lysine zyada) hain, is liye mukhalif charges aik doosre ko khenchte hain.

items: Octamer ke gird 146 nucleotides = nucleosome (11 nm string); H1 jorta.
30 nm fibre, 300 nm supercoil, 700 nm chromatid.
